unit: Bounded-subsolution local energy moments and canonical grid energy control
files_read: Complete new chapters/inputs/q08-local-energy-moments.tex directly read twice at statement-to-proof scale around the first stable build and visual inspection. Exact Q02 local Lp proof, canonical compactness/Hartogs statement and proof, Q08 Blocki common-collar estimate and bounded-density Dirichlet interface consulted; earlier verification evidence retained.

proof_scope: Finite measure dominated by a bounded local subsolution; smaller-ball common-collar truncation; M^n Blocki estimate; explicit all-real-p>=1 sublevel and moment estimates; optimized layer integral; half-open cube averages and fixed-scale negative-psh Lp estimate; bounded-density zero-boundary solutions with uniform energy moments; quadratic reference measure gives L2 and full-ball L1 subsequential compactness. n>=1, zero measure/energy and no subsolution boundary regularity explicit. No limit equation, self-integral convergence, unbounded product or general mixed inequality asserted.
review_method: Two scoped direct mathematical/editorial reads by the authoring agent, not independent certification. Eighteen first selected manuscript pages inspected, including all six index pages after repairing omitted terminal entries. All445 pages rendered against a forced second build; no pixel changes. Identical first images retain their visual review.
remaining_obligations: Canonical self-integral/capacity convergence and identification of the limit equation.
General common-measure mixed inequality, unweighted relative uniqueness, FN, positivity, separate envelope PDE/contact scopes, exact PartI overlap and whole-prequel polishing.
